name: itecs-petra-security
description: ITECS Petra Security tools to audit which clients are on Petra and how many licenses each is billed for, with the monthly license evidence for billing reconciliation.

interface.longDescription: Bundled read-only Petra Security tools: client tenants, license usage, billable users and a per-client license audit for billing. Uses the existing local command-backed configuration.
defaultPrompt: Audit which clients are on Petra Security and how many licenses each is billed for this month.
